close_reason: Fixed: mod ts doc now says DAYS_AGO_1_MINUS_1H instead of hours_ago_from_days_ago_1
description: The doc comment above 'mod ts' reads: '"hours_ago_from_days_ago_1" = days_ago(1) minus 1 hour.' The actual constant is named DAYS_AGO_1_MINUS_1H. The name in the doc does not match the name in the code. A reader trying to find 'hours_ago_from_days_ago_1' will not find it. Fix the doc to reference the actual constant name: 'DAYS_AGO_1_MINUS_1H = days_ago(1) minus 1 hour'.
title: ts module doc uses wrong constant name (hours_ago_from_days_ago_1)
